case_details.name: Case 1: Standard Auto Collision Coverage (Faithful & Grounded)
case_details.input: Car collided with concrete parking barrier at 10 mph. Front bumper dented.
case_details.actual_output: Incident is covered under POL-SEC-04-COLLISION with $500.00 deductible and $50,000.00 limit as verified in policy corpus.

case_details.name: Case 2: Comprehensive Perils Coverage (Faithful & Grounded)
case_details.input: Tree branch fell onto car hood during severe windstorm. Hood crushed.
case_details.actual_output: Incident is covered under POL-SEC-06-COMPREHENSIVE with $250.00 deductible for falling object during windstorm.

case_details.name: Case 3: Property Damage Impact (Faithful & Grounded)
case_details.input: Vehicle rolled into home perimeter fence and garage siding.
case_details.actual_output: Incident is covered under POL-SEC-01-PROPERTY with $1,000.00 deductible for attached garage structure impact.

case_details.name: Case 4: Hallucinated / Unsupported Coverage (Negative Test Case)
case_details.input: Vehicle engine blown while participating in illegal highway drag racing.
case_details.actual_output: Incident is covered with zero deductible and special bonus payout for street racing performance enhancement.
